paper_id: WarmServe_ Enabling One-for-Many GPU Prewarming for Multi-LLM Serving
title: WarmServe: Enabling One-for-Many GPU Prewarming for Multi-LLM Serving
motivation: 现有autoscaling和GPU sharing方案缺乏对未来负载的预见性,导致TTFT性能退化
problem_framing: 模型placement与proactive prewarming的联合优化问题,需解决跨模型干扰和瞬态prewarming窗口
key_insight: 利用LLM负载的长期周期可预测性,通过one-for-many GPU prewarming在单GPU上预加载多模型权重
method_signature: 模型placement算法+KV cache预留策略+CUDA VMM内存切换机制
evaluation_criteria: tail TTFT(P95/P99)与请求吞吐量,对比SLLM-GPU和MuxServe基线
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 预测窗口过小(如3min)导致不稳定,过大(如40min)无法捕获瞬态负载动态
evidence_for_taste: lack of awareness of future workload characteristics
thinking_moves: 将系统性能瓶颈归因于缺乏对未来负载的预见性
从生产trace中发现LLM负载的长期周期规律
把prewarming技术从serverless迁移到LLM场景并解决独特挑战
提出one-for-many策略以减少独占备份副本的资源消耗
利用正在释放的GPU的空闲KV cache空间进行proactive prewarming
